links.outcome: Performance drop when transporting suicide prediction models to new datasets
links.effect: Transfer performance declined versus local: average AUC reduced by up to 7.7%, sensitivity by up to 16% and PPV by up to 2% at 90% specificity; sensitivity by up to 20% and PPV by up to 5% at 95% specificity.
links.quote: Significant and comparable decreases in the transfer performance compared to the local performance of all three ML models were observed, with the decline in performance reducing average AUC by up to 7.7%, reducing average sensitivity by up to 16%, and PPV by up to 2% at the 90% specificity level, and reducing sensitivity by up to 20% and PPV by up to 5% at the 95% specificity level.

screen.reason: Empirically evaluates the cross-dataset transportability and performance drop of adolescent suicide prediction models across different health systems and data types (claims vs. EHR).
